NEXT100-025-DATA-UA-GOV-OPEN rights evidence
Captured: 2026-08-26

Dataset:
https://data.gov.ua/dataset/644b424e-9884-43cb-8204-0214657f2248

Publisher / data controller:
Державна служба України з питань геодезії, картографії та кадастру

Dataset title:
Реєстр наборів даних, що перебувають у володінні розпорядника інформації

Dataset page reuse statement:
- Open data are published for free access and are permitted for further free use and redistribution.
- Any person may freely copy, publish, distribute, use (including commercially), combine with other information, or include the open data in their own product, with mandatory attribution/link to the source.
- The dataset is marked “Creative Commons Attribution”.
- The data.gov.ua portal footer states CC BY 4.0 for portal content unless otherwise stated.

Project rights interpretation:
- acquisition/storage/analysis: ALLOWED
- model-training use: ALLOWED under the dataset’s explicit broad reuse grant
- redistribution: ALLOWED with mandatory source attribution/link
- evaluation: NOT_ADMITTED by this authority
- attribution is mandatory
- no rights inference is made merely from government provenance
- only the machine-readable dataset resource selected and hash-bound by this worker is in scope
- linked datasets, attachments, employee lists, and other resources are outside scope unless separately bound
